put.summary: Store immutable private encrypted bytes on this node
put.description: Bearer and account/device transaction signatures are required. Body SHA-256 must equal the path. Maximum 16 MiB. Blobs are scoped to account and active app; they are excluded from mesh replication.

head.summary: Check an account-private ciphertext blob before resuming upload

delete.summary: Delete an account-private blob the account no longer references
delete.description: Bearer and account/device transaction signatures are required. The blob stops counting toward the account's storage. Deleting a missing blob also succeeds.

post.summary: Move an account-private blob to the trash
post.description: Bearer and account/device transaction signatures are required, with an empty body. A trashed blob stays readable but stops counting toward the account's storage at once. The node deletes it after its trash period, 30 days after it was first trashed by default, unless it is restored or stored again. Trashing a blob already in the trash also succeeds.

post.summary: Take an account-private blob out of the trash
post.description: Bearer and account/device transaction signatures are required, with an empty body. The blob counts toward the account's storage again, so a full account is refused with storage_full. Restoring a blob that is not in the trash also succeeds.
